title: Data Architect
summary: Architect responsible for the realization of information in data structures, flows, history mechanisms and authoritative sources.
body_markdown:
# Data Architect

## Purpose

Design data architecture that realizes information models within principles and standards.

## Responsibilities

- Design logical models and data flows.
- Decide history, integration and MDM approaches (with ADRs).
- Designate authoritative sources.
- Perform impact analysis.

## Decision Rights

Data architecture level: logical structures, integration style, history mechanism; above threshold via [[Architecture Board]].

## Inputs

Information models; principles; platform capabilities.

## Outputs

Logical models; ADRs; data flow designs.

## Required Competencies

Data modeling; integration; temporal data; governance.

## Escalation Paths

Cross-domain or principle exceptions → [[Architecture Board]].

## Related Governance Processes

- [[Decision Rights Model]]
- [[Architecture Change Process]]
- [[Governance Lifecycle]]
